title: Pilchard and potato salad
steps: Boil the potato in its skin in salted water for 15 to 20 minutes, until a knife slides in easily. Drain it, let it cool and cut it into cubes.
Slice the onion thinly, chop the tomato and tear the lettuce.
Break the pilchards into chunks. The bones are soft and fine to eat.
Toss everything gently with the sauce from the tin, a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.
